people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”
translations.bsb: So Israel made a vow to the LORD: “If You will deliver this people into our hands, we will devote their cities to destruction.”
translations.kjv: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
translations.asv: And Israel vowed a vow unto Jehovah, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
